title: Veli-and-Amos
tagline: Video streaming Dapp - Livepeer API- https://jwp.io/s/u1hoKVHR
description: This is a demo app to showcase how to use Livepeer.com APIs to create a live stream and play with JWPlayer. The app enables the user to create a stream and play it back via JWPlayer while tracking video analytics which can be accessed on the JWPlayer Dashboard. Best practice for this Dapp, is using gitpod.io
how_its_made:
This app uses NextJS api routes to communicate with the Livepeer.com API and JWPlayer API. Checkout https://github.com/Bild96/veli-and-amos/tree/main/pages/api/ directory for the relevant code. To start a video stream, please use a broadcaster software like OBS/Streamyard on desktop, or Larix on mobile. Playback URL:

https://cdn.livepeer.com/hls/dcb2vmg61j2n1oz9/index.m3u8
